data.exact_reserve_text: The 2016 and prior years of account have Reinsured to Close ("RITC") into Barbican Syndicate 1955 for an RITC premium of GBP 42.5m. Under Lloyd's Accounting rules, the Syndicate's 2016 year of account closed at the end of 2018, with a return equal to (7.69%) of capacity. For further information on the RITC premium, see Note 7 in the Notes to the Underwriting Year Accounts.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2018 were GBP 183.372m, closing at 31 Dec 2018 at GBP 211.626m. The report does not explicitly disclose a single gross prior-year development figure. The syndicate experienced significant large losses and heavy attritional claims, particularly within Marine and Energy, and had material exposure to multiple 2018 catastrophe events (Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi, Camp and Woolsey wildfires, Lurssen Shipyard loss). Additionally, 2016 and prior years were reinsured to close into Barbican Syndicate 1955 (RITC premium GBP 42.5m) with the 2016 year closing at a (7.69%) return of capacity. These factors indicate adverse development on reserves overall, but no explicit gross prior-year movement number is provided.
raw_causal_phrases: the Syndicate experienced some significant large losses as well as heavy attritional claims, especially within the Marine and Energy books, which have significantly impacted the result.
The Syndicate has material exposure to Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi, the Camp and Woolsey Wildfires and the Lurssen Shipyard loss in the 2018 year of Account.
Last year, the Syndicate had material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria in the 2017 Year of Account.
During the year, the exposure to Hurricanes Irma and Maria deteriorated; however, there has been an improvement for Hurricane Harvey.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit single gross prior-year development (PYD) figure is provided in the notes. The report contains a gross claims development triangle (see notes) and P&L rows for 'Claims incurred in the prior accident years' (gross GBP 46,506k) but that P&L row is NOT the PYD movement and was therefore not used. The 2016 RITC into Barbican Syndicate 1955 (GBP 42.5m) and the closure of the 2016 Year of Account may distort comparisons and the claims triangle for PYD calculations. Because no clear gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line item was found, prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null.
